acceptanceCriteria: Confirm the documented global pre-verb placement against current official supported help and a clean clone affected read.
Clarify the automation example if ambiguous, retaining read-only scope, full immutable base and argument refusal behavior.
body: Observed 2026-10-01 with official Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163 and Tasks build 202; clean origin/main adf8358220769b8d6724ad27d27625602b8a7c62. User requested faster GitHub merge approval using Corvint selection. Investigation and independent Sol/low review retained in /private/tmp/corvint-ci-approval-findings.json. No CI checks or qualification were waived. Suspected documentation ambiguity: docs/AUTOMATION.md says each step takes --root PATH, while its step syntax does not show placement. Official installed build 163 rejects corvint affected --root PATH --base FULL_SHA with invalid-arguments/unrecognized arguments. Its help declares corvint [--root PATH] affected ...; running in the target cwd works. Expected guidance should make global pre-verb placement explicit. No parser defect is claimed and no compatible parser behavior should be changed.
title: docs: clarify global --root flag placement in triggered automation guidance
